text:
ryan.sales: Hey team — FinServCo asked for our SOC 2 artifacts and a short NDA so they can share sample data for the POC. They also want a one-page bridge letter stating we maintain SOC 2 controls while the new report is in progress. Meeting with their legal on Thursday. Can Legal + Security advise on quickest path? :point_up:

nora.legal: We can provide a mutual NDA (standard template) and a bridge-letter draft. Prefer we avoid fully redlined NDAs for quick POC access — suggest a short MUTUAL tempfile NDA. I'll attach the template in a sec. :file_folder:

olivia.sec: Quick Qs — what's the scope they need? Is it SOC 2 Type II for infra + app, or do they want system description that covers dedicated/private deployments? If they plan to send production data we need to confirm encryption/KMS and retention controls.

ryan.sales: They requested Type II and want evidence around encryption and access controls. They might prefer private deployment but said POC can start with hosted if we provide the bridge letter.

alex.poc: For POC we just need a synthetic dataset initially. If we can get the NDA signed today we can move faster. I can prepare a sanitized dataset to demo integration.

nora.legal: Ok — here's what I can do today: 1) share our standard MUTUAL-PoC-NDA (1 page) for quick signature; 2) prepare a bridge-letter draft that summarizes scope covered by our last SOC 2 (controls + period) and states we maintain controls during report renewal. I need confirmation of the exact control areas customer cares about (e.g., encryption, logging, access).

olivia.sec: Copying checklist for bridge letter: 
- control families included (CC1-CC7)
- last SOC 2 period/end date
- statement of ongoing adherence + point of contact
- note about hosted vs private deployments (clarify if hosted is acceptable for POC)

jamie.se: Pricing note for Ryan — if they escalate to a dedicated environment later, we should include estimated uplift in the follow-up (approx +20% for reserved pool during POC). Not blocking signature though.

ryan.sales: Thanks. Nora — can you drop the NDA link here? Olivia — I'll confirm which control families they flagged in the legal call (meeting Wed). Alex — hold the sanitized dataset until NDA is in place.

nora.legal: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/MUTUAL-POC-NDA-v3.pdf. Also past bridge letter we used for RetailCo attached. Draft snippet below — I can tailor it: 
```
To whom it may concern,

Redwood Inference confirms that as of [date] our SOC 2 Type II report for the [system name] covered the following control categories: information security, availability, confidentiality and processing integrity. While the next reporting period is pending, Redwood maintains the described controls and monitoring processes. This letter is provided solely to support evaluation activities for a limited POC and does not alter the scope of our formal SOC 2 attestation.

Sincerely,
Redwood Legal
```

security-bot: Incident history check — FinServCo domain shows no previous security incidents with us.

olivia.sec: That draft looks fine. Add an explicit line about encryption at rest with KMS and role-based access for POC datasets. Also include contact: security@redwood.com for controls questions.

nora.legal: Will add encryption/KMS line and send both docs for e-signature. ETA ~2 hours. If customer pushes back on mutual NDA we can offer Redwood-first NDA with limited PII clause.

ryan.sales: Awesome. If we can get NDA and bridge letter signed today we can schedule POC kickoff for Friday. I'll update the customer after you share the docs. :thumbsup:

jamie.se: I'll prep a short pricing appendix for the POC options (hosted vs dedicated) to attach to the NDA package, so legal sees cost path.

ryan.sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post an update after the legal call. :eyes:
